title: docs-only: backlink #8323's measured cross-tenant oracle from R11's (`unique/unscoped-declared-index`) doc comment
body:
Follow-through from the #8379 closure (maintainer ruling A, 2026-08-13: closed as already-satisfied). Filed by the triage seat as the accepted optional half of that ruling.

## What

Add a one-line backlink in the doc comment of `lintUnscopedDeclaredIndexes` (rule `unique/unscoped-declared-index`, R11, `packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts`) pointing at #8323's end-to-end measurement of the cross-tenant 409-vs-201 oracle — the concrete harm the rule's warning exists to prevent.

## Why

#8379 existed because part 3 of the #8323 ruling was written without knowing R11 already delivered its substance — the connection between the rule and the measured oracle lived nowhere in the tree. A one-line backlink makes the next sweep/ruling find R11 instead of re-deriving (or re-mandating) it. The #8379 dev report's evidence index is the source map.

## Scope

- One doc-comment line. No rule logic, no tier, no message text, no verdict change.
- `skip-changeset` (docs-only, not user-visible).

Size: S, mechanical. Related: #8379 (closed, the ruling) · #8323 (the measurement) · #5082 (the v18 endgame R11 backlinks already).

Filed unassigned by the triage seat Routine.
